name: nonzero mean
domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 随机响应的期望不为零的状态。

complete_examples.text: The nonlinearity type can lead to the nonzero mean of system response even if the mean of excitation is zero.
The PDFs of the responses are asymmetric about the nonzero mean values due to the existence of even nonlinearities.
